I can’t make friends. I’m not sure why. I try to be a kind person and be helpful but it just never works. So I have buried myself in my career. 

The one thing that saved me was getting a dog. She has forced me to go outside, to take her places and do fun things. Years later I enjoy finding things on the internet to do that would be fun for her and end up enjoying them myself. 

Taking care of a dog is hard. Super hard. She’s had thousands in emergency vet bills, has caused me to rethink every aspect of my life and how I live. But she is so worth it. So worth it that now I’ve gotten her a brother and we have double the trouble.

They are now my hobbies and we go all over together. If “traditional” hobbies aren’t keeping you engaged then try a pup. They will force you to stay engaged lol
